nodes.label: Repository Layout
nodes.rationale: Frontend lives in ./frontend and backend in ./server.

nodes.label: Backlog Workflow Gate
nodes.rationale: Non-trivial implementation work must first be checked against BACKLOG_WORKFLOW.md to decide whether it requires a Backlog task; questions, exploration, and obvious mechanical changes are exempt.

nodes.label: Session Handoffs Archive
nodes.rationale: Append-only custom archive in backlog/handoffs/ preserves durable agent memory across sessions; older entries must not be overwritten.

nodes.label: Documentation Authoring Rules
nodes.rationale: One Markdown sentence per physical source line and one row per table line keep diffs and formatting CI deterministic; glossary terms must use canonical forms.

nodes.label: Frontend Working Defaults
nodes.rationale: Default to frontend/ work, clean layout-based fixes, and regression tests before frontend bug fixes; new regression tests may intentionally fail to expose an existing bug.

nodes.label: Server Test Workflow
nodes.rationale: Mongo-backed route tests run through the isolated compose.test.yaml overlay so test state stays separate from development databases and is repeatable in CI.

nodes.label: Backend Conventions
nodes.rationale: Go module path timeful/server; MongoDB access confined to server/db/; dated migration scripts under server/scripts/; Swag annotations regenerate API docs; plugin payload shape changes require updating PLUGIN_API_README.md.

nodes.label: Cross-Cutting Frontend Rules
nodes.rationale: Boundary/transport types stay separate from internal types, one canonical internal shape per concept, coercions only at explicit boundaries, centralized timezone decoding, and Temporal value semantics; many Temporal regressions are runtime issues invisible to typecheck.

nodes.label: Required Frontend Checks
nodes.rationale: Frontend work must pass npm run lint, typecheck, build, and test:unit.

nodes.label: Local Frontend Debug Workflow
nodes.rationale: Production-oriented compose.yaml plus repo-local override; Vite dev server proxies /api and /swagger to VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET so requests stay same-origin and avoid CORS issues.

nodes.label: Local Firefox E2E Verification
nodes.rationale: Browser E2E uses the isolated test stack (mongo-test, postgres-test, server-test on 3003, Vite on 4174) and must never target a development database; TEST_DB_PERSIST controls state retention.

nodes.label: Rewrite Safety
nodes.rationale: When cleaning the worktree for history rewrites, prefer moving or copying files aside over rm as the primary cleanup mechanism.

nodes.label: Graphify Query Workflow
nodes.rationale: Codebase questions start with graphify query/path/explain against graphify-out/graph.json; run graphify update . after code changes.
